title: ParsedIntent
description: T-12: the contract for 'what a parsed intent looks like', shared between the NLU stage (Phase 3, produces this) and the confirm-intent stage (Phase 4, consumes this). intent_type values must exactly match nlu.taxonomy.IntentType (T-17) -- see tests/test_parsed_intent_schema.py::test_intent_enum_matches_taxonomy.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this document shape. Bump policy is formalized in T-16.

trace_id.description: The T-6 trace_id this query is carrying end to end.

intent_type.description: One bucket from the T-17 taxonomy, including out_of_scope.

entities.description: Typed spans extracted from the query (T-19). May be empty, e.g. for out_of_scope.

value.description: The raw extracted span from the query, e.g. 'last month'.

normalized_value.description: The normalized form (T-19), e.g. an ISO date range or resolved plant code. Type varies by entity_type, so left unconstrained here.

confidence.description: T-21 confidence scoring output: one overall score plus optional per-entity scores.
